# iod25

The goal of iod25 is to provide R users with easier access to the
English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (IoD25).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("douglasmunro/iod25")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`domains25`](https://douglasmunro.github.io/iod25/reference/domains25.md)
  : Domains of deprivation 2025
- [`imd25`](https://douglasmunro.github.io/iod25/reference/imd25.md) :
  Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) 2025
- [`population25`](https://douglasmunro.github.io/iod25/reference/population25.md)
  : Population denominators 2025
- [`subdomains25`](https://douglasmunro.github.io/iod25/reference/subdomains25.md)
  : Sub-domains of deprivation 2025
- [`supplementary25`](https://douglasmunro.github.io/iod25/reference/supplementary25.md)
  : Supplementary indices of deprivation 2025
